subject.title: OpenAI auth availability diverges from effective model routing

question: Should this be delivered as one coordinated cross-surface repair or as a canonical runtime/auth primitive followed by tightly linked consumer migrations?
rationale: The bug is established, but the maintainer-protected change crosses stable runtime, auth, Gateway, CLI, onboarding, doctor, and compaction ownership boundaries.

options.title: Primitive then migrations
options.body: Define the canonical route-aware eligibility result first and migrate every named consumer in a coordinated change or tightly linked sequence.

options.title: Single broad repair
options.body: Replace all affected heuristics in one larger change with comprehensive fresh-install, upgrade, runtime, and reporting validation.

recommendation.title: Primitive then migrations
recommendation.body: Define the canonical route-aware eligibility result first and migrate every named consumer in a coordinated change or tightly linked sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the live assignee and is connected through current-main history to the routing and availability implementation.
